name: Mariano Martin Giannetta
bioAdditions: Mariano (Martin) died in Scranton on 24 February 1941, aged about 41. The state death index records him twice, as 'Mariano Giannett' and as 'Martin Genette', under the same file number 18787 (S1). In the 1910 census he appears as 'Marianna', son, 11, and in 1920 as 'Marion', 20, a coal-breaker laborer (S2, S3). His widow was Mary (Santoli). Their daughter Angela Genett, 20, of 138 Sand Street, married Anthony Joseph DePietro at Dunmore on 16 Oct 1943, with her mother's consent because her father was dead (S4).
